title: Player checks out at the kiosk
description: When leaving the club, a present member opens Check-out on the kiosk, enters their PIN, and leaves today’s attendance.

steps.title: Check-in kiosk
steps.body: The same kiosk mode handles leaving: members who are present see Check-out on their row.

steps.title: Find your name while present
steps.body: Alex Rivera is already checked in for today, so their row shows Check-out.

steps.title: Start check-out
steps.body: Tap Check-out on your row. The kiosk asks for the same score PIN used at check-in.

steps.title: PIN prompt
steps.body: Confirm your identity with your PIN before the system records the check-out.

steps.title: Enter PIN and confirm
steps.body: Type the PIN, then confirm Check-out. A correct PIN ends the open visit for today.
steps.actionHint: Click Check-out after entering the PIN

steps.title: Checked out
steps.body: Attendance updates: the member is no longer present, the row returns to Check-in (free re-entry if they return today), and the present count drops.
steps.resultNote: PIN accepted; open visit closed for this member.
